Class PlatformPreset.Builder

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.platform.testing.PlatformPreset.Builder
Enclosing class:
PlatformPreset
public static final class PlatformPreset.Builder extends Object
Builds a PlatformPreset. The properties and variables set one by one are applied last, over the ones the preset computes from the operating system, the user name and the home directory.

    • userName

      public PlatformPreset.Builder userName(String userName)
      Sets the name of the user, test by default. Unless given, the home directory is the default one for that user: /home/name on Linux and other Unix-like systems, /Users/name on macOS, C:\Users\name on Windows.
      Parameters:
      userName - the user name
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if userName is blank

    • home

      public PlatformPreset.Builder home(String home)
      Sets the home directory of the user, which the other directories of the user, such as APPDATA on Windows, are under.
      Parameters:
      home - the home directory, in the syntax of the operating system, such as /home/alice or D:\Users\alice
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if home is blank

    • xdgVariables

      public PlatformPreset.Builder xdgVariables(boolean xdgVariables)
      Sets whether to set every variable of the XDG Base Directory Specification, each to a location that differs from the specification's default: XDG_DATA_HOME=/xdg/data-home, XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/xdg/config-home, XDG_STATE_HOME=/xdg/state-home, XDG_CACHE_HOME=/xdg/cache-home, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/xdg/runtime-dir, XDG_DATA_DIRS=/xdg/data-dir/first:/xdg/data-dir/second and XDG_CONFIG_DIRS=/xdg/config-dir/first:/xdg/config-dir/second. By default none is set.

      They can be set on any operating system, to check that only Linux and other Unix-like systems read them.

      Parameters:
      xdgVariables - true to set the XDG variables
      Returns:
      this builder
